scope: Agent documentation and skills, ownership catalog, structural checker, index generator and documentation tests.
interpretation: Summarizes independent reviewer responses. Approvals bind their scoped artifact hashes, not all files in an evolving checkout. The scope-review root predates the routing link to this record; it is a historical freeze, not the current generated index root. This record is not a cryptographic signature or runtime enforcement of review.
runtime_scope: Installed Relay drivers, profiles, policy/template data, benchmark examples and recorded fixture inputs were not changed. Documentation tooling is executable and was independently tested and mutation-probed.

checks.limits: These checks do not decide semantic prose freshness. Historical model runs were not reproduced; approval of their documentation preserves bounded historical claims. Runtime checks were selected by individual reviewers, not represented as a full-suite pass.

meaningful_rejection_controls: Missing cold-review H2, invalid skill metadata, broken parsed Markdown links, empty/malformed inventories, missing or overlapping source ownership.
Physically external source/test symlink targets, test-path traversal, nested PermissionError and FileNotFoundError inventories.
FileNotFoundError after scandir acquisition/entry yield must reject instead of producing a partial green inventory.
Removing the actual arm-hook catalog row must name bin/relay-arm-hook.sh as unowned.
Changing actual nested skill bytes without regenerating must make index --check fail.
Independent scratch mutations of duplicate-owner detection and post-open inventory handling produced PASS -> FAIL -> PASS after restoration.
